task.description:
Step 4 — write the regression tests for ISS-0125.

Read in full first:
- docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md (especially §11 pipelines, §5 fixtures, §9 report format)
- docs/anti-patterns.md
- docs/issue-reports/ISS-0125-root-cause.md
- src/design/iss-0125-fk-cascade.md (acceptance criteria section)
- The migration at migrations/1106_iss0125_instance_definition_snapshots_cascade.sql
- One of the existing test files for style: tests/integration/iss601_state_snapshots_test.zig
- tests/integration/helpers.zig (now-updated TestHarness shape)

NO DEFERRED WORK. Every MUST requirement has a fully-implemented integration test.

Produce TWO test artefacts:

1. `tests/specs/ISS-0125.md` — spec file in markdown describing each test case GIVEN/WHEN/THEN.

2. `tests/integration/iss0125_cascade_test.zig` — Zig integration test that asserts:
   a. After zig build migrate, the FK constraint on public.instance_definition_snapshots.definition_id has confdeltype='c' (CASCADE). Use the `pg_constraint` system catalog joined with `pg_namespace` (no shortcut to `information_schema`).
   b. CREATE a process_definitions row, CREATE an instance_definition_snapshots row referencing it, DELETE FROM process_definitions WHERE id=... — the DELETE must succeed AND the snapshot row must be gone (assert count=0 in WHERE definition_id=<the_id>).
   c. Self-isolation: the test uses per-test UUIDs (do not share fixtures with other tests). Use TestHarness.init(allocator) and the helpers' per-test fixtures pattern.
   d. Migration re-applicability: after dropping the CASCADE FK and re-running `zig build migrate`, the FK must be back to ON DELETE CASCADE. This validates the migration's idempotency contract.

Integration test contract:
- All assertions must use real PostgreSQL (BPM_TEST_DB_URL).
- No `error.SkipZigTest` for any test in this file (a skipped MUST test = requirement stays PENDING).
- No mocks, stubs, in-memory fakes (DIRECTIVE T-1).
- Use per-test UUIDs, not shared fixtures.
- The test must fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is not set.

Add `tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration/iss0125_cascade_test.zig` to confirm exit 0 (no BLOCKER).

If the user-visible flow requires pipeline tests, examine whether any of the GitHub-listed surfacing tests (TC-ISS-202-02/05, TC-ISS-203-03/04/05, TC-ISS-601-01..09, TC-EE-08-04, TC-EE-10-04/05/06, TC-EXP-202-01/02/03, TC-ES-03-01) need a `pl.step()` insertion in an existing pipeline file. Read `docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md §11.10` for the pipeline inventory and check if a relevant pipeline file exists. If yes, insert the step. If no, do NOT create a new pipeline file (this is a backend-schema-fix workflow, not a sequential UI journey).

Commit:
  git branch --show-current   # must be feature/WF03-gh391-20260801
  git add tests/specs/ISS-0125.md tests/integration/iss0125_cascade_test.zig
  git commit -m "test(WF03-gh391): regression tests for ISS-0125 ON DELETE CASCADE"
  git push origin feature/WF03-gh391-20260801

When done, update `handoffs/WF03-gh391-20260801/step-04-test-designer.json`:
- status: "COMPLETED"
- result.status: "PASS"
- result.summary: short description
- result.artifacts_out: ["tests/specs/ISS-0125.md", "tests/integration/iss0125_cascade_test.zig"]
- result.issues: []
- result.next_action: "Route to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (Step 4b)"
- completed_at: exact output of `(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")`

Also update `handoffs/registry.json`: mark entry `WF03-gh391-step04` as COMPLETED with the same completed_at.

Return PASS/FAIL summary.

result.summary: Created ISS-0125 test specification and four real PostgreSQL Zig regression tests covering FK CASCADE, parent-delete cleanup, idempotent migration replay, and cleanup error propagation.
